title: April 22, 2026
summary: The 'Remember me' login window was reduced from 30 days to 2 hours to meet security requirements. Improvements: custom consent forms now show a preview instead of a thumbnail; sorting by participant rating always places unrated participants at the bottom, regardless of sort order. Fixes: funding approval requests no longer make the modal disappear and toggle incentives off; studies funded by a Team wallet can now be closed when the refund exceeds the Team's available funds; duplicating a study no longer errors if a former collaborator no longer has access.
body_markdown: The "Remember me" login window was reduced from 30 days to 2 hours to meet security requirements.
